Simplify Consumable Catalog (00076 phase-1 + UI shrink) (#152)

* feat(mercury): add 00075 consumable catalog simplification

Forward-compat migration: paper-type identifiers and seeds, category
slugs, App-only category refs, and relaxed obsolete print-spec constraints
without editing 00074 or dropping columns yet.

* feat(mercury): shrink consumable and paper-type APIs

Drop device-compatibility and material-type surfaces, flatten categories,
require paper-type identifiers, and let App Studio read enabled paper
types with consumables or device-product permissions.

* chore(api): refresh OpenAPI baseline for consumable shrink

Capture the simplified consumable/paper-type contract and regenerate the
platform TypeScript client so generate-check matches the live schemas.

* feat(vega): simplify consumable catalog under /platform/consumables

Move list, categories, and paper types into a dedicated Consumables area,
strip retired print/compat fields from the shared editor, and keep legacy
device-catalog routes as redirects.

* fix(consumables): keep inactive dictionary values visible on edit

Include the currently assigned category or paper type in selectors even
when it is disabled, and point comments at migration 00076 after rebasing
onto main's 00075 lifecycle change.

* style(vega): prettier consumable catalog sources

* fix(mercury): resolve 00076 seed actor without role.created_by

Bootstrap leaves platform_owner.created_by null, so paper-type seeding
now prefers the bound platform identity (then any identity) for CI fresh DBs.

* fix(mercury): adapt integration tests to paper-type identifiers

Require identifier on CreatePaperType, tolerate 00076 seeds in list
assertions, use a BCP-47 region for orphan fixtures, and recreate the
retired storage_migrations stub so 00042 can replay on modern schemas.

* fix(mercury): drop only existing storage profile constraints in replay

The post-00042 schema uses provider_configuration_check, not the older
csm_storage_profiles_check name the replay fixture should not drop.

* fix(mercury): query app-logo orphans by zh-CN region

After retiring the invalid default region key, List/insert fixtures must
use the same BCP-47 region as the test storage profile.

* fix(mercury): use zh-CN for live app-logo orphan fixture

Match the region check constraint and profile used by the rest of the
replacement-failure integration test.

* fix(mercury): set zh-CN logical region on Bellatrix E2E seed storage

CreateProfile/PutBinding require a BCP-47 logical region; empty keys fail
validation and blocked seed-bellatrix-e2e once integration tests went green.

* fix(mercury): make Bellatrix seed admin setup idempotent

Skip CreateInitialAdministrator when tenant 1 already has an admin so
re-seeding does not hit authorization replay/actor failures, and allow
tenant_administrator permission supersets from later migrations.

* fix(vega): resolve assignment app names by row tenant

Assignment rows looked up app labels from the assign-form tenant's app
list, so cross-tenant rows could show the wrong name or only the id.

* fix(mercury): seed Bellatrix E2E fixtures with in-memory OSS by default

Browser E2E runs seed without live OSS credentials; fall back to the same
in-memory object store the integration test already uses.

* fix(mercury): ensure zh-CN region before Bellatrix E2E seed storage

Fresh browser-E2E databases have no logical regions after migrate, so
CreateProfile failed with invalid authorization change on requireActiveRegions.

* Share Bellatrix E2E objects via directory store across seed and API.

Process-local in-memory OSS left Mercury unable to load release payloads for Playwright; use a filesystem store plus a tiny HTTP server in CI.

* Serve directory-store E2E objects with sniffed image/png Content-Type.

Python's default http.server returned application/octet-stream for extensionless keys, breaking the Bellatrix file download assertion.
